biography.name: Shrey Singh
biography.title: Full-Stack & AI Engineer
biography.lead: I build full-stack products end to end: Python services, Next.js front ends, and the AI and geospatial pipelines in between, mostly for problems that citizens and governments actually have.
now: I'm a **Computer Science undergraduate at Manipal University Jaipur**, and most of what I know comes from shipping. Over the past year I've built a GIS platform for disaster relocation for **Smart India Hackathon**, a multi-agent legal assistant, a real-time vision system, and a civic grievance platform that won **India Innovates 2026**.

Lately I've been working on retrieval and agent systems: cited answers over legal rulebooks, multilingual voice input with Sarvam, and running LLMs locally. I care about the unglamorous parts, like provenance, tests and a clean PR history, as much as the interface.
biography.footer: Based in Jaipur · Open to internships and a good conversation.

featured.title: The Dead Zone
featured.description: Decision support for relocating communities out of disaster-prone districts, built for Smart India Hackathon. It maps multi-hazard risk onto Uber H3 cells, checks whether destination sites can carry the extra load on water, schools and health care, and plans household-to-site moves.
featured.stack: Python, FastAPI, PostGIS, Uber H3, Sentinel-1 SAR, Next.js, MapLibre GL, GSAP

featured.title: JanSamadhan
featured.description: Civic grievance platform for Delhi with citizen, worker, authority and admin portals. Complaints are routed to the right one of nine departments and escalated on SLA timers; citizens can file by voice through Sarvam speech-to-text or a multilingual chatbot.
featured.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Supabase, PostGIS, OpenCV, Sarvam AI, GSAP

featured.title: NyayaAI
featured.description: Multi-agent legal guidance for Indian citizens. A LangGraph intake agent turns a free-form story into structured case details and asks follow-ups until the case is complete.
featured.stack: LangGraph, Groq, Pydantic, Sarvam OCR, Next.js, Three.js

featured.title: Batman-Vision
featured.description: A webcam that remembers what it has seen. YOLOE with ByteTrack picks the sharpest crop of each object, de-duplicates by embedding, and makes everything searchable.
featured.stack: Python, YOLOE, FastAPI, SQLite FTS5, Next.js

featured.title: Sarthi
featured.description: Answers questions on the MP Bhumi Vikas Rules for municipal clerks in English, Hindi or Hinglish, with the rule number and page. Also on Apple Watch and WhatsApp.
featured.stack: Next.js, FastAPI, hybrid RAG, Sarvam AI, SwiftUI

featured.title: YouTube Playlist Search
featured.description: Open-source browser extension that adds search and match-to-match navigation to YouTube playlists of any length. Live on Firefox Add-ons.
